rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
rows[7]['pre1918']='no'

 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(rows)==94
for x,r in zip(items,rows):
 assert x['item_id']==r['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(r['slots'])==set(r['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in r['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in r['confidence'].values())
 assert r['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(v for r in rows for v in r['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(rows),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts),'total',sum(counts.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(r['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for r in rows))
